# sendln

Sends data with new-line.

```ttl
sendln <data1> <data2>....
```

## Remarks

Causes Tera Term to send characters followed by a new-line character to the host.
Format of &lt;data&gt; is the same as the "[send](send.md)" command.

## Example

```ttl
; Only a new-line character is sent.
sendln

sendln 'abc'

Password='mypassword'
sendln Password
```

See also "[setsync](setsync.md)" for the synchronous mode.
